title: ewwf-surrender-2002-world
label: Despair

won.source: /promotions/ewwf-surrender-2002/archive/surrender-2002-10-02.html

how: Pinned Simon Solkoff in a handicap match (with Kyle Archer) after Adam Mitchell counted the fall himself, Randy Love having interfered on Solkoff's side.
note: Retained against Simon Underwood by submission (Human Torment) on 10 October, special referee Derek Irvin ringing the bell; also retained against Syko at the unheld “To Hell and Back” (a bout this packet does not hold). Lost the title to Harvester of Sorrow in a three-way with Ashlyn Summers on 5 December.

how: Rolled up champion Smoove for the pin after Larry Gionet's interference, EWWF Surrender, 16 April 2002.

title: ewwf-surrender-2002-us
label: Axel Reed

won.source: /promotions/ewwf-surrender-2002/archive/redemption-2002-06-05.html

how: Beat champion Jimmy Slade in a Three Way King of the Hill scaffold match (also eliminating Jack Paine) after Larry Gionet's interference, Redemption.
note: Lost the title back to Jimmy Slade the same night in a mandated immediate rematch.

title: ewwf-surrender-2002-extreme
label: Despair

won.source: /promotions/ewwf-surrender-2002/archive/surrender-2002-04-16.html

how: Retrieved the championship from atop a ladder in a parking-lot ladder match against Randy Love, after a debuting Larry Spikowski choked Love unconscious and carried him off, EWWF Surrender, 16 April 2002.
note: Lost to Homeless Joe Boxcar around 10 July 2002 (shown only in a recap clip on the 17 July broadcast, after Ryan Sanders' interference); the card carrying this loss is not itself held.

title: ewwf-surrender-2002-extreme
label: Homeless Joe Boxcar

how: Pinned champion Despair after Ryan Sanders' interference (recap clip, card not held).
note: Lost the title back to Despair the same night (17 July) after Trinity interference.

title: ewwf-surrender-2002-extreme
label: Despair

won.source: /promotions/ewwf-surrender-2002/archive/surrender-2002-07-17.html

how: Trinity members Simon Underwood and Junya Kontani ambushed champion Homeless Joe Boxcar and placed the unconscious Despair to be declared the winner.
note: Retained against Junya Kontani at Redemption (5 June) and against Homeless Joe Boxcar at Kingdom of the Wicked (21 August). No document in this packet shows how the title passed from Despair to Ashlyn Summers, who debuts as champion on 8 August.

note: Retained against Andrew Krumm on 17 July; lost the title to Randy Love on 30 July.

how: Beat champion Jimmy Slade with a sunset flip rollup, 30 July 2002.
